blocks.text: Modal fe'llar (can, could, may, might, must, should, will, would, shall, need, ought to) harakatning o'zini emas, so'zlovchining unga **munosabatini** bildiradi: qila oladimi, ruxsat bormi, shartmi, ehtimoli qanday. Grammatikasi qizil kitobdan ma'lum (→ qizil kitob, 29–33-darslar): `-s` olmaydi, do / does ishlatilmaydi, keyin **to siz V1** keladi. Bu ilovada modal fe'llar **ma'no** bo'yicha guruhlangan va har bir guruhda hozirgi hamda o'tgan shakllar yonma-yon berilgan (→ 26–37-darslar). Bitta modal fe'lning bir nechta ma'nosi bor: **must** — ham majburiyat (You must stop), ham xulosa (He must be tired).

rows: o'tmish haqida: taxmin, tanqid, amalga oshmagan imkoniyat

blocks.text: O'tmishni ifodalashning ikki yo'li bor. Ba'zi modal fe'llarning o'tgan shakli **boshqa fe'l** bilan yasaladi: must → **had to**, can → **could / was able to**. **modal + have + V3** esa o'tmishdagi faktni emas, o'tmish haqidagi **fikrni** bildiradi: xulosa (must have gone — ketgan bo'lsa kerak), afsus yoki tanqid (should have gone — borish kerak edi), amalga oshmagan imkoniyat (could have gone — borsa bo'lardi).
Qobiliyat: can, could, be able to

rows: darak gapda could emas; inkorda couldn't mumkin
will be able to / have been able to / to be able to
I**'ll be able to** help you.

items.text: My grandmother **can** still **thread** a needle without glasses.
items.translation: Buvim hali ham ko'zoynaksiz ignaga ip **o'tkaza oladi**.

items.text: We **managed to get** the last two tickets for the concert.
items.translation: Konsertga oxirgi ikkita chiptani **olishga muvaffaq bo'ldik**.

items.text: You **could have told** me the meeting was cancelled!

rows: Can I ...? / Could I ...? / May I ...?
Can you ...? / Could you ...? / Would you ...? / Would you mind + `-ing`?
You can't ... / You may not ... / You mustn't ...
could (umumiy) / was allowed to (umumiy va bir martalik)
Bir martalik: We **were allowed to** leave early yesterday.
zarur — so'zlovchining fikri yoki rasmiy qoida
didn't have to / didn't need to

items.text: You **mustn't drive** after drinking even one glass of wine.
items.translation: Hatto bir qadah vino ichgandan keyin ham mashina **haydash mumkin emas**.

items.text: We **didn't need to take** a taxi, so we walked.
items.translation: Taksiga **o'tirishimiz shart emas edi**, shuning uchun piyoda bordik.

items.text: We **needn't have taken** a taxi — the station was just round the corner.
items.translation: Taksiga **o'tirmasak ham bo'lar ekan** — vokzal shundoqqina burilishda ekan.

blocks.text: Maslahat va tanqid: should, ought to, had better

**should** va **ought to** — maslahat yoki «to'g'ri ish shu»; ma'nosi deyarli bir xil, ought to biroz rasmiyroq. **had better** (qisqasi **'d better**) kuchliroq: «qilmasang, yomon bo'ladi» — ogohlantirish ohangi bor (→ 35-dars). O'tmish uchun **should have + V3** — «qilish kerak edi, lekin qilinmadi» (afsus, tanqid), **shouldn't have + V3** — «qilmaslik kerak edi, lekin qilindi» (→ 33–34-darslar).

items.text: You**'d better see** a doctor about that cough.
I **shouldn't have stayed** up so late — I can hardly keep my eyes open.
items.translation: Bunchalik kech **yotmasligim kerak edi** — ko'zimni zo'rg'a ochib turibman.

items.text: You **ought to thank** her for all her help.
items.translation: Shuncha yordami uchun unga **rahmat aytishingiz kerak**.

blocks.text: Dalillarga qarab xulosa chiqarganda modal fe'l ishonch darajasini ko'rsatadi (→ 28–30-darslar). Bu yerda **must** majburiyat emas, «aniq shunday bo'lsa kerak» degani; uning inkori **mustn't** emas, **can't**. O'zbekchada bu ma'nolar ko'pincha «-sa kerak», «-gandir», «bo'lishi mumkin emas» bilan beriladi.

items.text: Kamola isn't answering — she **must be** in a meeting.
He **can't have seen** us; he walked straight past.
items.translation: U bizni **ko'rgan bo'lishi mumkin emas**, to'ppa-to'g'ri o'tib ketdi.

items.text: The road is closed. There **might have been** an accident.

blocks.text: will va would: odat, ko'nmaslik, muloyimlik

rows: He **will talk** for hours if you let him.
We **would swim** in the canal every day.
I **would have come**, but I was ill.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «You must to go.» → You must **go** (modaldan keyin to yo'q; faqat ought to, have to, be able to da bor); «I must went there yesterday.» → I **had to go**; «He can't come yesterday.» → he **couldn't come**; «You mustn't come tomorrow» deb «shart emas» demoqchi bo'lish → You **don't have to** come (mustn't — taqiq!); «He must be went home.» → He **must have gone** home; «I could pass the exam yesterday.» (bir martalik) → I **managed to pass** / **was able to pass**; «should of» → should **have** (og'zaki 've ni «of» deb yozmang).

Ikki juftni yodda tuting. **mustn't** = «qilma!», **don't have to** = «qilmasang ham bo'ladi». **didn't need to** = «kerak emas edi» (odatda qilinmagan), **needn't have done** = «qildim, lekin bekorga». O'tmish haqida fikr bildirmoqchi bo'lsangiz — modal + **have** + V3: o'zbekchadagi «-gan bo'lsa kerak», «-ish kerak edi», «-ishi mumkin edi» ga shu shakl to'g'ri keladi.

Bog'liq darslar: → 26–27 (can, could, could have), 28 (must / can't), 29–30 (may / might), 31–32 (have to, must, needn't), 33–34 (should), 35 (had better), 36 (would), 37 (iltimos, taklif, ruxsat), 43 (majhul infinitiv: can be done); asoslari → qizil kitob, 29–34-darslar.

examples.title: Ability: **can**, **could**, **was able to**, **managed to**
examples.description: Hozirgi qobiliyat — can; o'tmishdagi umumiy qobiliyat — could; o'tmishdagi aniq bir vaziyatda uddalash — was able to / managed to; boshqa zamonlarda — be able to; amalga oshmagan imkoniyat — could have.

sentences.text: Nodir **can speak** four languages, including Korean and Turkish.
sentences.translation: Nodir to'rtta tilda, jumladan koreys va turk tillarida **gapira oladi**.

sentences.text: When I was younger, I **could run** five kilometres without stopping.
sentences.translation: Yoshligimda besh kilometrni to'xtamasdan **yugura olardim**.

sentences.text: The fire spread quickly, but everyone **was able to get** out of the building.
sentences.translation: Olov tez tarqaldi, lekin hamma binodan **chiqib ketishga ulgurdi**.

sentences.text: After three hours of searching, we finally **managed to find** a parking space.
sentences.translation: Uch soatlik qidiruvdan keyin nihoyat mashina qo'yishga joy **topa oldik**.

sentences.text: I**'ve** never **been able to understand** why people queue all night for a new phone.
sentences.translation: Odamlar yangi telefon uchun nega tun bo'yi navbatda turishini hech **tushuna olmaganman**.

sentences.text: Will you **be able to come** to the conference next month?
sentences.translation: Kelasi oy konferensiyaga **kela olasizmi**?

sentences.text: I **couldn't sleep** last night because the neighbours were having a party.
sentences.translation: Kecha tunda **uxlay olmadim**, chunki qo'shnilar ziyofat qilishayotgan edi.

sentences.text: You **could have won** the race if you hadn't stopped to tie your shoe.
sentences.translation: Poyabzal bog'ichini bog'lash uchun to'xtamaganingda, poygada **yutishing mumkin edi**.

sentences.text: **Can** you **see** the minarets of Khiva from the top of this tower?
sentences.translation: Bu minora tepasidan Xiva minoralarini **ko'ra olasizmi**?

sentences.text: Despite the heavy snow, the pilot **managed to land** the plane safely.
sentences.translation: Kuchli qorga qaramay, uchuvchi samolyotni xavfsiz **qo'ndira oldi**.

examples.title: Permission and requests: **Could you**, **May I**, **Would you mind**
examples.description: Iltimos va ruxsat so'rash: Can / Could I ...? (could — muloyimroq), May I ...? (rasmiy), Would you mind + `-ing`? O'tmishdagi ruxsat — could / was allowed to.

sentences.text: **Could** you **turn** the music down a little? I'm trying to work.
sentences.translation: Musiqani biroz **pasaytira olasizmi**? Ishlashga harakat qilyapman.

sentences.text: **May I ask** a question before we move on to the next topic?
sentences.translation: Keyingi mavzuga o'tishdan oldin bitta savol **bersam maylimi**?

sentences.text: **Would** you **mind opening** the window? It's very stuffy in here.
sentences.translation: Derazani **ochib yubormaysizmi**? Bu yer juda dim.

sentences.text: **Can I use** your charger for a minute? My phone is almost dead.
sentences.translation: Zaryadlovchingizdan bir daqiqa **foydalansam bo'ladimi**? Telefonim o'chib qolay deyapti.

sentences.text: Visitors **may not take** photographs inside the mausoleum.
sentences.translation: Tashrif buyuruvchilar maqbara ichida **suratga olishlari mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: As children, we **were allowed to stay** up late only on New Year's Eve.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimizda faqat Yangi yil kechasi kech yotishimizga **ruxsat berilardi**.

sentences.text: When I was a student, I **could borrow** up to ten books from the library.
sentences.translation: Talabaligimda kutubxonadan o'ntagacha kitob **olishim mumkin edi**.

sentences.text: **Do** you **mind if** I **sit** here? — No, not at all, go ahead.
sentences.translation: Shu yerga **o'tirsam maylimi**? — Albatta, marhamat.

sentences.text: **Could** I possibly **change** my appointment to Thursday afternoon?
sentences.translation: Qabulimni payshanba tushdan keyinga **ko'chirsam bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: You **can't park** here — it's reserved for ambulances.
sentences.translation: Bu yerga mashina **qo'yish mumkin emas** — u tez yordam mashinalari uchun ajratilgan.

examples.title: Obligation: **must**, **have to**, **mustn't**, **don't have to**
examples.description: must — so'zlovchi zarur deb hisoblaydi yoki rasmiy qoida; have to — tashqi majburiyat; mustn't — taqiq; don't have to — shart emas. O'tmishda faqat had to.

sentences.text: I **must call** my grandmother tonight — it's been a week since we spoke.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun buvimga albatta **qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak** — gaplashmaganimizga bir hafta bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Nurses **have to work** night shifts at least twice a month.
sentences.translation: Hamshiralar oyiga kamida ikki marta tungi smenada **ishlashlari shart**.

sentences.text: You **mustn't tell** Laylo about the surprise party — it's a secret!
sentences.translation: Layloga kutilmagan ziyofat haqida **aytmasligingiz kerak** — bu sir!

sentences.text: You **don't have to bring** anything — we've got plenty of food.
sentences.translation: Hech narsa olib kelishingiz **shart emas** — ovqatimiz ko'p.

sentences.text: We **had to wait** two hours at the border because the computers were down.
sentences.translation: Kompyuterlar ishlamay qolgani uchun chegarada ikki soat **kutishga majbur bo'ldik**.

sentences.text: **Do** staff **have to wear** a uniform in your hotel, or can they choose?
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonangizda xodimlar forma **kiyishi shartmi** yoki o'zlari tanlashlari mumkinmi?

sentences.text: All passengers **must show** their boarding passes at the gate.
sentences.translation: Barcha yo'lovchilar chiqish eshigida bortga chiqish talonini **ko'rsatishi shart**.

sentences.text: I**'ve got to go** now, or I'll miss the last bus.
sentences.translation: Endi **ketishim kerak**, aks holda oxirgi avtobusga ulgurmayman.

sentences.text: Will we **have to pay** extra for the luggage?
sentences.translation: Yuk uchun qo'shimcha **to'lashimizga to'g'ri keladimi**?

sentences.text: Bekzod **didn't have to work** on Saturday, so he took his son fishing.
sentences.translation: Bekzod shanba kuni **ishlashi shart emas edi**, shuning uchun o'g'lini baliq oviga olib bordi.

examples.title: **needn't**, **didn't need to**, **needn't have done**
examples.description: needn't / don't need to — zarurat yo'q; didn't need to — zarurat yo'q edi (ko'pincha qilinmagan); needn't have + V3 — qilindi, lekin keragi yo'q ekan.

sentences.text: You **needn't shout** — I can hear you perfectly well.
sentences.translation: **Baqirishingiz shart emas** — sizni juda yaxshi eshityapman.

sentences.text: We **didn't need to book** a table because the restaurant was almost empty.
sentences.translation: Stol **band qilishimizga hojat yo'q edi**, chunki restoran deyarli bo'sh edi.

sentences.text: I **needn't have cooked** so much plov — half the guests didn't come.
sentences.translation: Shuncha ko'p palov **pishirmasam ham bo'lar ekan** — mehmonlarning yarmi kelmadi.

sentences.text: **Need** I **bring** my passport, or is my ID card enough?
sentences.translation: Pasportimni **olib kelishim kerakmi** yoki ID karta yetarlimi?

sentences.text: She **needn't have worried** about the exam — she got the highest mark.
sentences.translation: U imtihondan **xavotir olmasa ham bo'lar ekan** — eng yuqori bahoni oldi.

sentences.text: Guests **don't need to bring** towels, as the sanatorium provides everything.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar sochiq **olib kelishlari shart emas**, sanatoriy hammasini beradi.

sentences.text: Thank goodness, we **didn't need to call** a plumber — Dad fixed the leak himself.
sentences.translation: Xayriyat, santexnik **chaqirishimiz kerak bo'lmadi** — dadam oqishni o'zi tuzatdi.

sentences.text: There's plenty of time, so we **needn't hurry**.
sentences.translation: Vaqt ko'p, shuning uchun **shoshilmasak ham bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **needn't have taken** a taxi — the hotel was only five minutes' walk away.
sentences.translation: Jasur taksiga **o'tirmasa ham bo'lar ekan** — mehmonxona atigi besh daqiqalik yo'l edi.

sentences.text: **Did** you **need to show** your vaccination certificate at the airport?
sentences.translation: Aeroportda emlanganlik sertifikatingizni **ko'rsatishingiz kerak bo'ldimi**?

examples.title: Advice and criticism: **should**, **had better**, **should have**
examples.description: should / ought to — maslahat, to'g'ri ish; had better — ogohlantirish; should have + V3 — qilish kerak edi, lekin qilinmadi; shouldn't have + V3 — qilmaslik kerak edi.

sentences.text: You **should try** the new Korean restaurant near the TV tower.
sentences.translation: Teleminora yaqinidagi yangi koreys restoranini **tatib ko'rishingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: We **ought to leave** now if we want to avoid the traffic.
sentences.translation: Tirbandlikka tushib qolmaslik uchun endi **yo'lga chiqishimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: You**'d better take** a jacket — it gets cold in the mountains at night.
sentences.translation: Kurtka **olib olganing ma'qul** — kechasi tog'da sovuq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: I **should have listened** to my father's advice about that car.
sentences.translation: O'sha mashina haqida otamning maslahatiga **quloq solishim kerak edi**.

sentences.text: You **shouldn't have eaten** so many sweets before dinner.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatdan oldin shuncha shirinlik **yemasliging kerak edi**.

sentences.text: **Should** I **tell** my boss that I'm looking for another job?
sentences.translation: Boshqa ish qidirayotganimni boshlig'imga **aytsammikan**?

sentences.text: The government **should do** more to reduce air pollution in the capital.
sentences.translation: Hukumat poytaxtdagi havo ifloslanishini kamaytirish uchun ko'proq **ish qilishi kerak**.

sentences.text: We**'d better not wake** the baby, or she'll cry all evening.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloqni **uyg'otmaganimiz ma'qul**, aks holda kechqurun bo'yi yig'laydi.

sentences.text: Kamol **ought to have apologised**, but he was too proud.
sentences.translation: Kamol **kechirim so'rashi kerak edi**, lekin u juda mag'rur edi.

sentences.text: It's a brilliant film — you really **shouldn't miss** it.
sentences.translation: Bu ajoyib film — uni aslo **o'tkazib yubormang**.

examples.title: Deduction now: **must be**, **can't be**, **might be**
examples.description: Hozirgi holat haqida xulosa: must — «aniq shunday bo'lsa kerak»; can't — «bo'lishi mumkin emas»; may / might / could — «balki»; should — kutilgan holat; must be + `-ing` — hozir davom etayotgan harakat haqida.

sentences.text: You've been travelling all day — you **must be** exhausted.
sentences.translation: Kun bo'yi yo'lda bo'lding — juda charchagan **bo'lsang kerak**.

sentences.text: That **can't be** Gulnoza's car; she sold it last month.
sentences.translation: Bu Gulnozaning mashinasi **bo'lishi mumkin emas** — u o'tgan oy uni sotgan.

sentences.text: Nobody's answering the phone. They **might be** at the bazaar.
sentences.translation: Telefonni hech kim ko'tarmayapti. Ular bozorda **bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The lights are on, so someone **must be** at home.
sentences.translation: Chiroqlar yonib turibdi, demak uyda kimdir **bor**.

sentences.text: Listen to that noise — the neighbours **must be having** a party.
sentences.translation: Anavi shovqinni eshit — qo'shnilar ziyofat **qilishayotgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: This bill **can't be** right — we only ordered two coffees!
sentences.translation: Bu hisob to'g'ri **bo'lishi mumkin emas** — biz faqat ikkita qahva buyurtma qildik-ku!

sentences.text: Where are my glasses? — They **could be** in the car; you were wearing them there.
sentences.translation: Ko'zoynagim qani? — Mashinada **bo'lishi mumkin**, u yerda taqib o'tirganding.

sentences.text: Why isn't Timur answering? — He **may be driving**, so let's try later.
sentences.translation: Nega Temur javob bermayapti? — Mashina **haydayotgan bo'lishi mumkin**, keyinroq urinib ko'ramiz.

sentences.text: If it was sent on Monday, the parcel **should be** here by Friday.
sentences.translation: Agar dushanba kuni jo'natilgan bo'lsa, posilka juma kunigacha **kelishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Malika has been revising all night, so she **must know** the material by now.
sentences.translation: Malika tun bo'yi takrorladi, demak hozir mavzuni **bilsa kerak**.

examples.title: Deduction about the past: **must have**, **can't have**, **might have**
examples.description: O'tmish haqida xulosa: must have + V3 (aniq shunday bo'lgan), can't / couldn't have + V3 (bo'lishi mumkin emas), may / might / could have + V3 (balki bo'lgandir), should have + V3 (kutilgan edi).

sentences.text: The streets are wet. It **must have rained** during the night.
sentences.translation: Ko'chalar ho'l. Kechasi yomg'ir **yog'gan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Aziz **can't have forgotten** your birthday — he talked about it all week!
sentences.translation: Aziz tug'ilgan kuningni **unutgan bo'lishi mumkin emas** — u hafta bo'yi shu haqda gapirdi-ku!

sentences.text: I can't find my keys. I **might have left** them in the office.
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni topolmayapman. Ofisda **qoldirgan bo'lishim mumkin**.

sentences.text: Sarah looks really upset. She **must have had** an argument with her boss.
sentences.translation: Sara juda xafa ko'rinadi. Boshlig'i bilan **janjallashib qolgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: That **couldn't have been** Rustam you saw — he's in Moscow this week.
sentences.translation: Siz ko'rgan odam Rustam **bo'lishi mumkin emas** — u bu hafta Moskvada.

sentences.text: Why didn't Laylo come? — She **may have been** too busy with her exams.
sentences.translation: Nega Laylo kelmadi? — Imtihonlari bilan juda **band bo'lgandir**.

sentences.text: The window was open when we got back, so the thief **must have climbed** in that way.
sentences.translation: Qaytib kelganimizda deraza ochiq edi, demak o'g'ri o'sha yerdan **kirgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: You **could have been** killed! Why did you cross the road without looking?
sentences.translation: **O'lib qolishing mumkin edi**! Nega qaramasdan yo'ldan o'tding?

sentences.text: The cake has disappeared. The kids **must have eaten** it while we were out.
sentences.translation: Tort g'oyib bo'libdi. Biz yo'qligimizda bolalar **yeb qo'ygan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Their plane **should have landed** by now — let's check the arrivals board.
sentences.translation: Ularning samolyoti hozirgacha **qo'ngan bo'lishi kerak edi** — kelish jadvalini tekshiraylik.

examples.title: **will** and **would**: habits, refusals, polite requests
examples.description: will — odatiy xatti-harakat; won't — ko'nmaslik, ishlamaslik; would — o'tmishdagi odat; wouldn't — o'tmishda ko'nmagan; Would you ...? — muloyim iltimos; would have + V3 — amalga oshmagan o'tmish.

sentences.text: Every summer my grandfather **would take** us to his orchard in Bostanliq.
sentences.translation: Har yozda bobom bizni Bo'stonliqdagi bog'iga **olib borardi**.

sentences.text: My cat **will sit** by the door for hours, waiting for me to come home.
sentences.translation: Mushugim uyga kelishimni kutib, eshik oldida soatlab **o'tiradi**.

sentences.text: I asked him several times, but he **wouldn't tell** me the truth.
sentences.translation: Undan bir necha marta so'radim, lekin u menga haqiqatni **aytishni istamadi**.

sentences.text: **Would** you **sign** here and here, please, Mr Karimov?
sentences.translation: Mana bu yerga va bu yerga **imzo qo'yib yuborasizmi**, janob Karimov?

sentences.text: The window **won't open** — I think it's been painted shut.
sentences.translation: Deraza **ochilmayapti** — bo'yab yopishtirib qo'yishgan shekilli.

sentences.text: I **would have helped** you, but nobody told me you were moving.
sentences.translation: Senga **yordam bergan bo'lardim**, lekin ko'chayotganingni hech kim aytmadi.

sentences.text: When we lived in Samarkand, we **would** often **walk** to the Registan in the evenings.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda yashaganimizda kechqurunlari Registonga tez-tez piyoda **borardik**.

sentences.text: That's typical of Jahongir — he **will leave** everything until the last minute.
sentences.translation: Jahongir doim shunaqa — hamma narsani oxirgi daqiqaga **qoldiradi**.

sentences.text: **Would** it **be** all right if I brought a friend to dinner?
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatga bir do'stimni olib kelsam **bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: Without your help, we **wouldn't have finished** the project on time.
sentences.translation: Sizning yordamingizsiz loyihani o'z vaqtida **tugata olmagan bo'lardik**.
